lastCompletedStory.title: Pin bun and Node versions with a shared toolchain reader

openQuestions: US-002's implementation is FULLY DONE and GREEN locally (commit 5c888ca on cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity: adds `bun-version-file: .bun-version` to the oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, adds checkBunVersionPin() + wiring in scripts/check-ci-parity.ts, new test fixtures, raised file-size-budget.json ceilings with a CAM-201 tracker ref). `bun run check:all` passes clean including the new ci-parity assertion. HOWEVER `git push origin cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity` is REJECTED by GitHub: 'refusing to allow a Personal Access Token to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` without `workflow` scope'. This is confirmed with two independent push attempts (default remote credential and an explicit x-access-token URL using $GITHUB_TOKEN), both rejected identically. This is a hard GitHub-side restriction on any push whose diff touches .github/workflows/**, not a transient/flaky failure, and it cannot be worked around from inside the implementer session (no --no-verify equivalent exists for this; it is enforced server-side by GitHub, not by a local hook). FIX REQUIRED (operator action): grant the configured PAT (`$GITHUB_TOKEN`) the `workflow` OAuth scope (or swap to a GitHub App installation token / fine-grained PAT with 'Workflows: write' permission), then re-run `git push origin cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity` from this same working tree (commit 5c888ca is already sitting on the branch, ready to push; no re-implementation needed). Once pushed, flip US-002's `passes` back to `true` in prd.json (it was flipped true then reverted to false by this session specifically because the push failed, per the BLOCKED_QUALITY contract that passes must reflect 'not shippable yet'). Until the token scope is fixed, DO NOT re-implement US-002 from scratch: read commit 5c888ca first, it is already correct.
Root cause verified: PAT scope, not a code defect. No test/gate change is needed once the operator grants the `workflow` scope.
nextStoryContext: US-001 (bun/node version pins + toolchain reader) is the true last-pushed-and-complete story. A follow-on session attempting US-002 should FIRST check `git log --oneline` on cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity for commit 5c888ca ('feat: US-002 - Pin CI bun via bun-version-file and enforce it in ci-parity'): if present, the implementation is already done (see openQuestions for exact contents) and the ONLY remaining action is `git push origin cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity` after the operator fixes the PAT's `workflow` scope, followed by flipping US-002.passes to true and re-writing this handoff. If push succeeds, US-003 (worker Dockerfile toolchain) should read readPinnedBunVersion/readPinnedNodeVersion from src/config/toolchain.ts directly to build the Docker build-arg, mirroring how checkBunVersionPin (added in the pending US-002 commit) consumes the same reader, rather than re-parsing .bun-version/.tool-versions or grepping ci.yml.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bun-version-file is a supported input on setup-bun@v2 that reads the pinned version from a file (e.g. .bun-version); without an explicit bun-version or bun-version-file input the action falls back through package.json packageManager/engines.bun and finally to 'latest'. The ci.yml change (adding bun-version-file: .bun-version) matches the documented API and eliminates the prior implicit 'latest' float. This validation stands even though the commit is not yet pushed.
